en.memory_turn: I attended a charity golf tournament on July 17th, and while I had a blast playing with colleagues, I realised I need to work on my swing. What drills can help a beginner?
en.assistant_reply: Try the towel drill, holding a towel under both armpits to keep your arms connected, and slow half-swings focused on a smooth tempo. Hitting balls with your feet together also improves balance.
en.followup_turn: How often should I practise at the range?
en.followup_reply: Two short sessions a week are better than one long one. Focus on a single drill each time instead of hitting a whole bucket without a plan.

en.q2: On what date did I play in the charity golf tournament?
en.q3: My manager wants to thank everyone who represented the company at the golf fundraiser. What date did I play there?
en.distractor_sentence: My boss played in a different golf tournament on August 2nd.

en.memory_turn: I volunteered at the Food for Thought charity gala on September 25th, which was a great experience. Now I'd like to organise a small fundraiser myself. Where should I start?
en.assistant_reply: Choose one clear cause and a realistic goal, then pick a simple format like a bake sale or a quiz night. Ask a local café or community hall to host it for free in exchange for publicity.
en.followup_turn: How do I get people to actually show up?
en.followup_reply: Personal invitations work best. Ask each helper to bring five friends, post reminders a week and a day before, and make it easy to donate online for anyone who can't come.

en.q2: On what date was the Food for Thought gala where I volunteered?

en.memory_turn: I went to a backyard BBQ party at my colleague's house on June 3rd, and they had an amazing selection of BBQ sauces. I want to make my own sauce now. Any simple recipe ideas?
en.assistant_reply: Start with ketchup, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder and a little mustard. Simmer for fifteen minutes and adjust the sweetness and tang to your taste.
en.followup_turn: How long does homemade sauce keep?
en.followup_reply: In a clean, sealed jar in the fridge it usually lasts about two weeks. Use a clean spoon each time so it doesn't spoil early.
